method: One timed sample per list from a successful focused test run; no statistical latency claim or latency threshold.
Fixtures are generated before timing. Source timing covers render and a synchronous End-key React update; dependency/binary render timing also covers saved-result promise resolution and a DOM query.
Page timings cover event dispatch and synchronous React DOM updates. Fixture API and event transport are test doubles; no network or scanning is timed.
The run uses Vitest workers alongside other workspace activity; values are observations from this environment.
Keyboard and accessibility attributes are verified by component tests; jsdom has no layout, paint or real screen reader.
regressionsObservedBeforeFix: 10,000 source findings rendered 10,000 option rows instead of a bounded page.
10,000 binary components rendered 10,000 outer list rows.
A single binary component with 10,000 CVEs rendered 10,000 CVE chips.
A group with 10,000 dependency advisories rendered 10,000 review rows; group pagination controls were absent.
SSE retry, stream replacement and hub lag notifications produced no frontend recovery events.
Real Shift+X produced no range action; a controlled selection could leave aria-activedescendant referring to an unmounted page row.
limitations: Pagination bounds rendered result records. The full fetched result remains in memory; filtering, dependency grouping and identity lookup still process the full result.
Variable metadata, warning text and dependency-path annotations are not covered by the record-count bound.
No external participant observations or usability acceptance are claimed.

additionalMeasurements.method: One timed jsdom sample. Fixture creation precedes timing; rendering includes mocked canonical receipt reads, React render and the DOM query. Last-page timing includes synchronous click dispatch and React DOM updates. No real scanning, network, layout or paint is measured.
